name: band-of-burning-verdict-enter-draw
notes:
Band of Burning Verdict (7mmve2l328, GeneratedMacroCode.php enterAbilities["7mmve2l328:0"]): "On Enter: Draw a card." Materialized for real from hand with a TAMER Guo Jia champion, FIRE element access, and an Animal/Beast ally (Cheerful Slime) already on the field. Verified live: the deck count drops by exactly 1 after materializing. Break/restore verified: commenting out the Draw() call makes the fixture fail and restoring it passes again.

ENGINE BUG (found, not fixed): two defects around this card's printed '[Class Bonus] [REST]: Target Animal or Beast ally you control gets +1 POWER and gains true sight until end of turn' clause, which is NOT gated behind [Guo Jia Bonus] or a materialize-time restriction on the actual card text: (1) GeneratedCode/GeneratedMacroCode.php activateCardPrereqs["7mmve2l328:0"] (~128-138) blocks materializing the card from hand AT ALL unless IsClassBonusActive($player,["TAMER"]) is true AND the player already controls an Animal/Beast ally -- neither condition is a printed restriction on playing the card, only on the separate [REST] ability. (2) cardActivatedAbilities["7mmve2l328:0"] (the [REST] buff ability body, ~16236-16243) is queued and resolved AUTOMATICALLY immediately after the card enters the field (confirmed live: after only playing the card and paying no [REST] cost, an MZCHOOSE for the printed buff target appeared unprompted, and answering it applied TRUE_SIGHT + a power-buff turn effect to the targeted ally) -- this activated, costed ability should only fire from an explicit later player activation, not automatically as part of materializing. Recommend removing both the TAMER-class-bonus/Animal-ally play-prereq gate and whatever wiring auto-queues the [REST] ability right after Enter.
